full_judgment: The petitioner as the plaintiff instituted Title Suit No.103 of 1993 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Keranigonj, Dhaka for permanent injunction: against the defendant-respondents. His case, in short, is, that the suit land originally belonged to Jabbar Matbar, who died leaving behind only son Nawab Ali and S. A. khatian was recorded in his name. After that, Nawab Ali sold 39 decimals of land appertaining to C. S. khatian No-15 and S. A. Plot No.194 to Gulrehan Bibi by a registered deed of sale dated 12.07.1974 and Gulrehan Bibi sold out the suit land by a No.1) by a registered deed of sale dated registered deed of sale dated 23.09.1982. Fazio! Haque mutated his 08.12.1989 to the plaintiff and handed name on 09.09.1987 by filing Mutation over possession to him. Accordingly, Case No.46 of 1987-88 and has been the plaintiff had been paying rents and possessing the suit land by paying rents possessing the suit land by cultivating Nawab Miah could not sell the suit land the same and the defendants have no right, title and possession in the suit land. Thereafter, on 22.10.1993, the defendants forcibly tried to enter into the suit land but failed and started threatening the plaintiff to dispossess from the suit land. Therefore, the plaintiff compelled to file the suit for permanent injunction.
